learnings.question: Which PCIe power management state is designed for the longest periods of inactivity, offering the highest power savings while requiring the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: In PCIe power management, the L2 state provides the highest power savings for the longest periods of inactivity, but it requires the longest wake-up time to resume activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic scripture (Quran 67:2), what is identified as the fundamental reason for the creation of life and death?
options: To eliminate all physical hardship on Earth
To experience earthly diversion and amusement
To establish material wealth and dominance
To test who is best in deed
learnings.learning: In Islamic teachings, earthly life and death were explicitly created as a divine test of conduct to determine who is best in deeds (Quran 67:2).

learnings.question: What is the standard format structure for a User Story within a Scrum Product Backlog?
options: As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]
learnings.learning: In Scrum, user stories in the Product Backlog follow the standardized structure: 'As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]'.

learnings.question: Comparing the estimated 12 million distinct Arabic words to the 170,000 words in the Oxford English Dictionary, what is the approximate ratio of Arabic words to English words?
learnings.learning: Arabic contains approximately 12 million distinct words compared to 170,000 English words in the Oxford English Dictionary, creating a ratio of roughly 71 Arabic words for every 1 English word.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Instead of relying solely on memory to retain important ideas and insights, what comprehensive approach ensures long-term retention and value?
options: Memorizing concepts through rote repetition and avoiding digital note-taking
Re-reading archived notes periodically while keeping them strictly private
Relying entirely on cognitive offloading without any follow-up review system
Writing them down, building an active recall system, and sharing them publicly
learnings.learning: Rather than trusting human memory to retain insights, effective knowledge management requires writing thoughts down, building a system to prompt active recall, and sharing that knowledge publicly.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One
